correctness.rationale: For any coupling, pointwise l1 and squared-l2 costs are bounded below by selecting an occupied coordinate or the maximal count respectively. Exchangeability with symmetric random tie-breaking makes the maximizer's label uniform, so both lower bounds are attained. Poisson second moments give 2+1/d-2 E[max Y_i]; the factorial-moment identity turns the excess over 2/e into a pointwise nonnegative collision functional, positive for any Y_i>=3. The first two maximum tail probabilities have Taylor coefficients x/2-11x²/24 and x²/6 at x=1/d; the remaining tail is at most x³/24, proving 7/(12d²)+O(d^-3). Actual package-path diagnostics include three finite truncated transport LPs and symbolic rational expansion. No experiment is treated as proof.

value.rationale: The object is the minimal mean-preserving high-dimensional Poissonization of exclusive categorical occupancy, motivated directly by published Bernoulli-vector Poisson approximation. Its exact W2 squared invariant gives a constructive optimizer, a strict collision discrepancy, and a sharp 7/12 high-dimensional correction after the unexpectedly canceled first-order term. The invariant allows concrete comparison of strength and geometry between l1 and quadratic transport; neither mere nonnegativity nor numerical reproducibility alone accounts for its value. It is deliberately restricted to this natural base model, and no broader approximation theorem is asserted.
